title: Interpretation and the parol evidence rule
question: What evidence may explain or add to a writing?

steps.note: Meaning from trade usage, dealings and the contract’s own terms; the plaintiff must prove the narrower meaning.
Evidence of a collateral agreement is admissible unless the parties would certainly have included it.
Words have no plain meaning apart from context; extrinsic evidence to show a reasonable meaning.
A reluctant application of Pacific Gas: even a clear clause may be explained by extrinsic evidence.
New York’s answer: an unambiguous writing is read on its face.
